title: Port exact-bit triangle soup welding and index-degenerate filtering
scope: Port weldTriangleSoup, hash3 and filterDegenerateTriangles from the pinned source, preserving first-seen vertex/index order and exact-bit comparison. Consume parser outputs with explicit budgets and return owned buffers; no scene/session mutation.
acceptance: Independent original/native/browser-Wasm comparisons include repeated vertices, signed zero, non-finite payloads, collisions, empty input, progress and degenerate triangle indices.
Preserve baseline behavior even where later upstream changes exist; bounded allocation and indexing errors.
open_items: Audit the full source and input guards before implementing; signed-zero identity follows pinned bits rather than a newer upstream fix.
Define and compare the owned positions/indices contract before claiming successful indexed scan import.
